request: user 2026-09-24: palm mutes are static, should move like a real hand; Hydra supports upstrokes, relevant for solo, rhythm is mostly downstrokes

hydra_manual.picking_mode: Up/Down/Alternate/Economy; keyswitches C7 Up, C#7 Down, D7 Alternate, D#7 Economy; Alternate flips per press
hydra_manual.palm_mute: MUTE Tightness knob; 'Vel -> Tightness: lower velocities will decay even faster' -- must be ON in the preset
hydra_manual.legato: overlap within 12 semitones; Force Same-String on by default (cross-string hammer 'not realistic')

pick_direction.rule: rhythm: down while IOI >= 140 ms (rhythm_downpick_min_ioi_ms), else 16th parity; solo: strict alternate over picked notes, legato targets skipped, rest > a beat -> down
pick_direction.keyswitch_numbers: 108 (C7 up), 109 (C#7 down) in the file's numbering (C-1 = 12); verify in the preset

palm_mute_motion.model: AR(1) velocity drift over consecutive P.M. hits: std 6, coherence 0.8, reset after a pause > a beat; own RNG stream
